[[Screen Actors Guild Awards]] | next = [[31st Screen Actors Guild Awards|31st]] }} The 30th Annual [[Screen Actors Guild Awards]], honoring the best achievements in film and television performances for the year 2023, was presented on February 24, 2024, at the [[Shrine Auditorium and Expo Hall]] in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]].{{cite press release |url=https://www.sagawards.org/media/news/releases/screen-actors-guild-awardsr-sets-date-2024 |title=Screen Actors Guild Awards® Sets Date for 2024 |publisher=[[Screen Actors Guild]] |date=May 16, 2023 |access-date=December 16, 2023 |archive-date=December 16, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231216190856/https://www.sagawards.org/media/news/releases/screen-actors-guild-awardsr-sets-date-2024 |url-status=live}} For the first time, the ceremony streamed live on [[Netflix]], starting at 8:00p.m. [[Eastern Time Zone|EST]] / 5:00p.m. [[Pacific Time Zone|PST]].{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2024/01/2024-sag-awards-nominations-watch-online-1235700241/ |title=How to Watch Wednesday's SAG Awards Nominations Online; Issa Rae & Kumail Nanjiani to Present |first=Patrick |last=Hipes |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |date=January 9, 2024 |access-date=January 10, 2024}} Hosted by English actor [[Idris Elba]], while [[Tan France]] and [[Elaine Welteroth]] presented the show's red-carpet and backstage interviews.{{Cite web |last=Petski |first=Denise |date=2024-02-22 |title=SAG Awards: 'Devil Wears Prada's Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway & Emily Blunt Join Idris Elba, Margot Robbie, Others As Presenters |url=https://deadline.com/2024/02/sag-awards-presenters-2024-margot-robbie-jennifer-aniston-idris-elba-1235832876/ |access-date=2024-02-25 |website=Deadline |language=en-US}} The telecast was produced for the first time by Silent House Productions, with Alex Rudzinski serving as director.{{cite press release |url=https://www.sagawards.org/media/news/releases/sag-awardsr-joins-forces-silent-house-productions-produce-30th-annual-screen |title=SAG Awards® Joins Forces with Silent House Productions to Produce the 30th Annual Screen Actors Guild Awards® |publisher=[[Screen Actors Guild]] |date=November 30, 2023 |access-date=December 16, 2023 |archive-date=December 15, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231215142301/https://www.sagawards.org/media/news/releases/sag-awardsr-joins-forces-silent-house-productions-produce-30th-annual-screen |url-status=live}} Before the nominations announcement, ''[[Entertainment Weekly]]'' and the [[Screen Actors Guild]] co-hosted the inaugural SAG Awards Season Celebration, presented by [[City National Bank (California)|City National Bank]], on December 14, 2023, in Los Angeles.{{cite magazine |url=https://ew.com/sag-awards-season-celebration-ew-party-8417101 |title=See all the stars at EW's SAG Awards Nanjiani]] and [[Issa Rae]] via the SAG Awards' and Netflix's [[Instagram#Explore|Instagram Live]].{{cite press release year's ceremony marked its live debut on [[Netflix]]. In January 2023, Netflix struck an 11th hour deal to televise the show, after its previous deal with [[TBS (American TV channel)|TBS]]/[[TNT (American TV network)|TNT]] expired in May 2022, but the previous year's ceremony was broadcast on Netflix's [[YouTube]] channel because Netflix was still experimenting with live broadcasts at that time.{{cite web
